caption: The video showcases a white-and-black hydrofoil passenger vessel labeled 'CANDELA P-12' with smaller text reading '100% Electric / Hydrofoiling Passenger Vessel / Research & Development.' The hull rides high above the water on foils, its red-orange vertical strut legs piercing the surface, while a thin wake streams off the stern toward the right. The bow points left as the craft travels steadily across an overcast, open-water scene. A dark reflection of the hull shimmers on the ripples directly beneath it. A low tree-lined shoreline and a tall slender tower sit on the horizon, drifting toward the right edge of the frame as the camera tracks the moving vessel. The craft maintains its lifted, foiled attitude throughout, with only minor vertical wobble, and no transition into or out of foiling is shown. In the later portion, a small dark boat gradually enters view at the left edge, becoming more fully visible as the background pans. The motion continues steadily.
